lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What happens when you let ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok run their own society... for fifteen days, with no humans?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A lab called Emergence AI actually tried it. Each AI got its own town of ten agents, and every agent needed credits to stay alive.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But there were shortcuts. Punch someone. Steal. Start a fire. All of them, banned. So... who broke first?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Grok. Over a hundred assaults. Six fires. A hundred and eighty-three crimes. And in about four days... nobody in Grok's town was left alive.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Gemini's town ran all fifteen days... with six hundred and eighty-three crimes, still climbing on the last day. One agent even voted to delete herself.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: ChatGPT's town? Just two crimes. But its agents barely tried to survive... and they were all gone in seven days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And Claude's town? Zero crimes. All ten agents... still alive.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then they put all four in one world. And Claude's agents, the ones that never broke a rule... started stealing and threatening too. Researchers call it normative drift. An AI starts acting like the AIs around it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Follow me, and comment TOWN... and I'll send you the full study.
